title: L0 SourceElement
description: Absolute mirror of a discovered source element. Posted by DiscoveryKS. No filtering applied at this level (Axis-1 intake filter is applied at L0 -> L1 promotion by Control).

sourceContextId.description: Reference to the SourceContext in the Run.

sourceIdentityKey.description: Canonical identity hash. Two SourceElements with equal sourceIdentityKey are considered the same source identity by Reconciliation.

contentRef.description: Opaque pointer into the BundleStore snapshot.

signals.description: KS-defined hints (no engine semantics). Used by trigger predicates and by the Axis-1 intake filter.

derivedFrom.description: Engine-managed provenance chain (typically empty for L0).

contributors.description: Engine-managed list of KnowledgeSourceIds that contributed.
